subject: DI03005031

body.en:
Definition

A heat exchanger transfers heat between streams at different temperatures. In an indirect exchanger a separating wall prevents intended mixing; direct-contact equipment transfers heat by contact between streams. Its heat duty is energy transferred per unit time, not its surface area.

Classification by flow pattern

Parallel/co-current: both streams enter the same end and flow in the same general direction. Counter-current: streams enter opposite ends and flow in opposite directions. Crossflow: stream directions are approximately perpendicular. Multipass arrangements combine directions and require the correct mean-temperature treatment.

Classification by function and construction

By function: heater, cooler, condenser, evaporator and reboiler. By construction: double-pipe, shell-and-tube and plate type. Classification axes are independent; a shell-and-tube unit may serve as a condenser or sensible cooler. Regenerators store and release heat cyclically, whereas ordinary recuperative units exchange continuously through a wall.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

અલગ temperatures ધરાવતા streams વચ્ચે heat transfer કરતું equipment એટલે Heat Exchanger. Indirect exchanger માં separating wall થી intended mixing અટકે છે. Direct-contact equipment માં streams ના contact દ્વારા transfer થાય છે. Heat Duty એટલે એકમ સમય દીઠ transferred energy, surface area નહીં.

Flow Pattern મુજબ વર્ગીકરણ

Parallel/Co-current માં બંને streams એક જ છેડેથી પ્રવેશીને સમાન દિશામાં વહે છે. Counter-current માં opposite ends થી પ્રવેશીને વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં વહે છે. Crossflow માં flow directions લગભગ perpendicular હોય છે. Multipass arrangement માં directions સંયુક્ત હોય છે અને યોગ્ય mean-temperature treatment જરૂરી છે.

Function અને Construction મુજબ વર્ગીકરણ

Function પ્રમાણે heater, cooler, condenser, evaporator તથા reboiler. Construction પ્રમાણે double-pipe, shell-and-tube અને plate type. આ independent classifications છે; એક shell-and-tube unit condenser અથવા sensible cooler બંને બની શકે છે. Regenerator માં cyclic heat storage/release થાય છે, જ્યારે સામાન્ય recuperative unit માં wall મારફતે continuous exchange થાય છે.

body.en:
Construction

A smaller tube is mounted concentrically inside a larger pipe. One fluid occupies the inner tube and the other the annular passage. Separate inlet/outlet connections, spacers, seals and supporting fittings maintain the two flow paths. Hairpin sections can provide a longer effective path in a compact layout; the arrangement may be connected for parallel or counter-current service. The drawing shows a simple counter-current unit.

Working

Hot fluid transfers heat by convection to the tube wall; heat conducts through that wall and passes by convection to the colder stream. The streams do not intentionally mix. Counter-current connection maintains useful driving temperature difference along the length and can permit a cold outlet hotter than the hot outlet, while local hot-to-cold temperature differences remain positive. Duty is checked by separate hot and cold energy balances.

Uses and limitations

Suitable for small duties, high-pressure tube-side service and modular installations. It is simple but becomes bulky and expensive per unit area for very large duties. The annulus can be difficult to clean unless the design provides access.
body.gu:
રચના (Construction)

નાની tube મોટી pipe ની અંદર concentric રીતે ગોઠવાય છે. એક fluid inner tube માં અને બીજું annular passage માં રહે છે. અલગ inlet/outlet connections, spacers, seals તથા supports થી બંને paths અલગ જળવાય છે. Hairpin sections થી ઓછા સ્થળમાં લાંબો effective path મળે છે. Parallel અથવા counter-current arrangement કરી શકાય છે; diagram simple counter-current unit દર્શાવે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Hot fluid થી convection દ્વારા tube wall સુધી heat આવે છે. Wall માં conduction અને cold side પર convection થી heat colder stream સુધી જાય છે. બંને streams નું intended mixing થતું નથી. Counter-current connection માં સમગ્ર length માં ઉપયોગી temperature difference જળવાય છે. Local hot-to-cold difference positive રહેતાં cold outlet, hot outlet કરતાં ગરમ થઈ શકે છે. Duty માટે hot તથા cold બંને energy balances તપાસવા.

ઉપયોગ અને મર્યાદાઓ

Small duties, high-pressure tube-side service તથા modular installation માટે ઉપયોગી છે. Construction simple છે, પણ ખૂબ મોટી duty માટે bulky અને area દીઠ મોંઘું પડે છે. Design માં access ન હોય તો annulus cleaning મુશ્કેલ બને છે.

body.en:
Construction

A bundle of tubes is enclosed within a cylindrical shell. Tube sheets secure tube ends and separate shell-side and tube-side fluids. Headers or channels distribute tube-side flow; partition plates create multiple tube passes when specified. Shell-side nozzles admit and remove the second stream. Baffles support tubes and direct shell-side flow across the bundle. A fixed tube sheet, U-tube or floating-head arrangement is selected to address thermal expansion and cleaning needs; these are design variants, not parts necessarily present in every exchanger.

Working

One stream enters the tube-side channel and flows through the tubes; the other enters the shell and follows the baffled route around them. Heat crosses the tube wall without intended fluid mixing. Baffles increase crossflow and mixing but also increase pressure drop. Correct nozzle/pass arrangement determines the actual temperature pattern; many practical units are not pure single-pass counterflow and require an LMTD correction factor. Leakage at a tube or tube-sheet joint can cause cross-contamination.

Uses and maintenance

Widely used as process heaters, coolers, condensers and reboilers over broad pressure/temperature ranges. Arrange drainage, venting, cleaning access and thermal-expansion allowance appropriately. Fouling and vibration reduce performance/reliability; isolate, depressurise and cool before inspection.
body.gu:
રચના (Construction)

Cylindrical shell ની અંદર tubes નો bundle હોય છે. Tube sheets tube ends પકડી રાખે છે અને shell તથા tube fluids અલગ રાખે છે. Headers/channels tube-side flow વહેંચે છે. Partition plates થી જરૂર મુજબ multiple tube passes મળે છે. Shell-side nozzles બીજા stream માટે છે. Baffles tubes ને support આપી shell flow ને bundle પરથી પસાર કરે છે. Thermal expansion તથા cleaning પ્રમાણે fixed tube sheet, U-tube અથવા floating-head design પસંદ થાય છે; આ variants છે, દરેક unit માં બધાં parts હોય એવું નથી.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

એક stream tube-side channel થી tubes માં જાય છે અને બીજું shell માંથી baffles દર્શાવેલા માર્ગે tubes ની બહાર વહે છે. Tube wall મારફતે heat transfer થાય છે, intended fluid mixing નહીં. Baffles થી crossflow તથા mixing વધે છે, પણ pressure drop પણ વધે છે. Actual temperature pattern nozzle/pass arrangement નક્કી કરે છે. ઘણી practical units pure single-pass counterflow નથી, તેથી LMTD correction factor જરૂરી છે. Tube અથવા tube-sheet joint leak થાય તો cross-contamination થઈ શકે છે.

ઉપયોગ અને જાળવણી

Process heaters, coolers, condensers તથા reboilers તરીકે broad pressure/temperature ranges માં ઉપયોગી છે. યોગ્ય drainage, venting, cleaning access તથા thermal expansion allowance જરૂરી છે. Fouling અને vibration થી performance/reliability ઘટે છે. Inspection પહેલાં isolate, depressurise અને cool કરવું.

body.en:
Construction

A plate-and-frame exchanger contains a stack of thin corrugated metal plates clamped between a fixed frame plate and a movable pressure plate. Gaskets or an appropriate sealed construction form alternating hot and cold channels. Corner ports and gasket patterns route each fluid only into its intended passages. Tie bolts maintain compression and a carrying bar supports the plate pack. The sketch is the gasketed variant; brazed and welded designs differ.

Working

Hot and cold streams enter separate port systems and flow through alternate narrow channels, usually arranged approximately counter-current. Corrugations promote mixing and mechanically support plates. Heat conducts through each thin plate while adjacent fluids remain separated. Multiple parallel passages distribute flow across the plate pack; unequal distribution or fouling can reduce the effective area. Gasketed units can be opened for inspection after safe isolation.

Advantages and limitations

Compact, high area density, high coefficients and close temperature approach are major advantages. Gasket compatibility, pressure/temperature limits, channel blockage by solids and cleaning needs must be checked. A plate exchanger is not automatically suitable for every slurry or high-pressure service.
body.gu:
રચના (Construction)

Plate-and-frame exchanger માં thin corrugated metal plates નો stack fixed frame તથા movable pressure plate વચ્ચે clamp થાય છે. Gaskets અથવા યોગ્ય sealed construction થી alternating hot અને cold channels બને છે. Corner ports અને gasket pattern દરેક fluid ને તેના જ passages માં દોરે છે. Tie bolts compression જાળવે છે અને carrying bar plate pack ને support આપે છે. Diagram gasketed variant બતાવે છે; brazed તથા welded designs જુદા હોય છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ (Working)

Hot અને cold streams અલગ ports થી alternate narrow channels માં સામાન્ય રીતે આશરે counter-current વહે છે. Corrugations mixing વધારે છે તથા plates ને mechanical support આપે છે. Thin plates મારફતે conduction થાય છે, પણ fluids અલગ રહે છે. Multiple parallel passages માં flow વહેંચાય છે. Unequal distribution અથવા fouling થી effective area ઘટે છે. Gasketed unit safe isolation પછી inspection માટે ખોલી શકાય છે.

લાભ અને મર્યાદાઓ

Compact size, વધુ area density, ઉંચા coefficients તથા close temperature approach મુખ્ય લાભ છે. Gasket compatibility, pressure/temperature limits, solids થી channel blockage તથા cleaning needs તપાસવી. દરેક slurry અથવા high-pressure service માટે plate exchanger આપમેળે યોગ્ય નથી.

title.en: LMTD correction factor and equal-end limit
title.gu: LMTD Correction Factor અને Equal-end Limit

h.en: LMTD correction factor and equal-end limit
h.gu: LMTD Correction Factor અને Equal-end Limit

body.en:
Correction-factor definition

For a multipass or crossflow exchanger, the actual mean driving difference is expressed as F times the ideal counter-current LMTD based on the same four terminal temperatures. F depends on the specific flow/pass arrangement and temperature ratios. Use the correct chart or validated correlation, not an arbitrary universal factor. Ordinary feasible charts give F at or below one; an infeasible temperature combination cannot be repaired by guessing F.

Corrected duty

Equal terminal differences and energy check

If both positive terminal differences are equal, the logarithmic mean equals that common difference; the apparent zero-over-zero is a limit, not zero duty. For a sensible exchanger at steady state with negligible loss, use both stream balances and compare measured values rather than force an exact match.

Limit and balances
body.gu:
Correction Factor ની વ્યાખ્યા

Multipass અથવા crossflow exchanger માટે actual mean driving difference ને સમાન ચાર terminal temperatures પરથી મળતા ideal counter-current LMTD ના F ગણા તરીકે દર્શાવાય છે. F flow/pass arrangement તથા temperature ratios પર આધારિત છે. યોગ્ય chart અથવા validated correlation વાપરો; universal guessed factor નહીં. સામાન્ય feasible charts માં F એક કે તેનાથી ઓછો હોય છે. Infeasible temperature combination ને guessed F થી સુધારી શકાય નહીં.

Corrected Duty

સમાન Terminal Differences અને Energy Check

બંને positive terminal differences સમાન હોય તો logarithmic mean તે common difference જેટલું થાય છે. દેખાતું zero-over-zero એક limit છે, zero duty નહીં. Steady sensible exchanger માં negligible loss હોય તો બંને stream balances લો. Measured values સરખાવો; જબરદસ્તી exact match ન બનાવો.

body.en:
Definition and causes

Fouling is accumulation of unwanted deposits on a heat-transfer surface. Scale is a deposit often associated with precipitation/crystallisation of dissolved salts. Other fouling includes suspended solids, biological growth and reaction/corrosion products. Deposits create an added thermal resistance and may narrow the flow passage.

Effects and control

For the same driving temperatures and area, fouling lowers overall U and duty; maintaining duty can require more utility or greater temperature difference. It can also increase pressure drop, maldistribution and local overheating. Control uses appropriate water treatment, filtration, compatible operating conditions, adequate flow and planned cleaning. Monitor temperatures, flow and pressure drop; choose cleaning chemistry only under the approved materials-compatible SOP.

Same-area fouling relation
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને કારણો

Heat-transfer surface પર અનિચ્છનીય deposits જમા થવાને Fouling કહે છે. Dissolved salts ના precipitation/crystallisation થી બનતો deposit ઘણીવાર Scale કહેવાય છે. Suspended solids, biological growth તથા reaction/corrosion products પણ fouling આપે છે. Deposits વધારાનો thermal resistance આપે છે અને flow passage સાંકડો કરી શકે છે.

અસર અને Control

સમાન driving temperatures અને area માટે fouling થી overall U તથા duty ઘટે છે. Duty જાળવવા વધુ utility અથવા temperature difference જરૂરી થઈ શકે છે. Pressure drop, maldistribution તથા local overheating પણ વધી શકે છે. યોગ્ય water treatment, filtration, compatible conditions, adequate flow અને planned cleaning જરૂરી છે. Temperature, flow તથા pressure drop monitor કરો. Cleaning chemistry ફક્ત approved materials-compatible SOP મુજબ પસંદ કરવી.

સમાન Area-basis પર Fouling સંબંધ

title.en: 13. Overall U of a double-pipe exchanger

h.en: 13. Overall U of a double-pipe exchanger

body.en:
Aim

Overall U of a double-pipe exchanger

Principle

q.en: State the definition/principle of Heat exchanger—definition and classification.
q.gu: Heat Exchanger—વ્યાખ્યા અને વર્ગીકરણ ની વ્યાખ્યા/મૂળ સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A heat exchanger transfers heat between streams at different temperatures. In an indirect exchanger a separating wall prevents intended mixing;direct-contact equipment transfers heat by contact between streams. Its heat duty is energy transferred per unit time,not its surface area. Parallel/co-current:both streams enter the same end and flow in the same general direction.Counter-current:streams enter opposite ends and flow in opposite directions.Crossflow:stream directions are approximately perpendicular.Multipass arrangements combine directions and require the correct mean-temperature treatment. By function:heater,cooler,condenser,evaporator and reboiler.By construction:double-pipe,shell-and-tube and plate type.Classification axes are independent;a shell-and-tube unit may serve as a condenser or sensible cooler. Regenerators store and release heat cyclically,whereas ordinary recuperative units exchange continuously through a wall.
a.gu: અલગ temperatures ધરાવતા streams વચ્ચે heat transfer કરતું equipment એટલે Heat Exchanger. Indirect exchanger માં separating wall થી intended mixing અટકે છે. Direct-contact equipment માં streams ના contact દ્વારા transfer થાય છે. Heat Duty એટલે એકમ સમય દીઠ transferred energy,surface area નહીં. Parallel/Co-current માં બંને streams એક જ છેડેથી પ્રવેશીને સમાન દિશામાં વહે છે. Counter-current માં opposite ends થી પ્રવેશીને વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં વહે છે. Crossflow માં flow directions લગભગ perpendicular હોય છે. Multipass arrangement માં directions સંયુક્ત હોય છે અને યોગ્ય mean-temperature treatment જરૂરી છે. Function પ્રમાણે heater,cooler,condenser,evaporator તથા reboiler. Construction પ્રમાણે double-pipe,shell-and-tube અને plate type. આ independent classifications છે;એક shell-and-tube unit condenser અથવા sensible cooler બંને બની શકે છે. Regenerator માં cyclic heat storage/release થાય છે,જ્યારે સામાન્ય recuperative unit માં wall મારફતે continuous exchange થાય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Double-pipe heat exchanger—construction and working.
q.gu: Double-pipe Heat Exchanger—Construction અને Working ની વ્યાખ્યા/મૂળ સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A smaller tube is mounted concentrically inside a larger pipe. One fluid occupies the inner tube and the other the annular passage. Separate inlet/outlet connections,spacers,seals and supporting fittings maintain the two flow paths. Hairpin sections can provide a longer effective path in a compact layout;the arrangement may be connected for parallel or counter-current service. The drawing shows a simple counter-current unit. Hot fluid transfers heat by convection to the tube wall;heat conducts through that wall and passes by convection to the colder stream. The streams do not intentionally mix. Counter-current connection maintains useful driving temperature difference along the length and can permit a cold outlet hotter than the hot outlet,while local hot-to-cold temperature differences remain positive. Duty is checked by separate hot and cold energy balances. Suitable for small duties,high-pressure tube-side service and modular installations.It is simple but becomes bulky and expensive per unit area for very large duties.The annulus can be difficult to clean unless the design provides access.
a.gu: નાની tube મોટી pipe ની અંદર concentric રીતે ગોઠવાય છે. એક fluid inner tube માં અને બીજું annular passage માં રહે છે. અલગ inlet/outlet connections,spacers,seals તથા supports થી બંને paths અલગ જળવાય છે. Hairpin sections થી ઓછા સ્થળમાં લાંબો effective path મળે છે. Parallel અથવા counter-current arrangement કરી શકાય છે;diagram simple counter-current unit દર્શાવે છે. Hot fluid થી convection દ્વારા tube wall સુધી heat આવે છે. Wall માં conduction અને cold side પર convection થી heat colder stream સુધી જાય છે. બંને streams નું intended mixing થતું નથી. Counter-current connection માં સમગ્ર length માં ઉપયોગી temperature difference જળવાય છે. Local hot-to-cold difference positive રહેતાં cold outlet,hot outlet કરતાં ગરમ થઈ શકે છે. Duty માટે hot તથા cold બંને energy balances તપાસવા. Small duties,high-pressure tube-side service તથા modular installation માટે ઉપયોગી છે. Construction simple છે,પણ ખૂબ મોટી duty માટે bulky અને area દીઠ મોંઘું પડે છે. Design માં access ન હોય તો annulus cleaning મુશ્કેલ બને છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Shell-and-tube heat exchanger—construction and working.
q.gu: Shell-and-tube Heat Exchanger—Construction અને Working ની વ્યાખ્યા/મૂળ સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A bundle of tubes is enclosed within a cylindrical shell.Tube sheets secure tube ends and separate shell-side and tube-side fluids.Headers or channels distribute tube-side flow;partition plates create multiple tube passes when specified.Shell-side nozzles admit and remove the second stream.Baffles support tubes and direct shell-side flow across the bundle.A fixed tube sheet,U-tube or floating-head arrangement is selected to address thermal expansion and cleaning needs;these are design variants,not parts necessarily present in every exchanger. One stream enters the tube-side channel and flows through the tubes;the other enters the shell and follows the baffled route around them.Heat crosses the tube wall without intended fluid mixing.Baffles increase crossflow and mixing but also increase pressure drop.Correct nozzle/pass arrangement determines the actual temperature pattern;many practical units are not pure single-pass counterflow and require an LMTD correction factor.Leakage at a tube or tube-sheet joint can cause cross-contamination. Widely used as process heaters,coolers,condensers and reboilers over broad pressure/temperature ranges.Arrange drainage,venting,cleaning access and thermal-expansion allowance appropriately.Fouling and vibration reduce performance/reliability;isolate,depressurise and cool before inspection.
a.gu: Cylindrical shell ની અંદર tubes નો bundle હોય છે. Tube sheets tube ends પકડી રાખે છે અને shell તથા tube fluids અલગ રાખે છે. Headers/channels tube-side flow વહેંચે છે. Partition plates થી જરૂર મુજબ multiple tube passes મળે છે. Shell-side nozzles બીજા stream માટે છે. Baffles tubes ને support આપી shell flow ને bundle પરથી પસાર કરે છે. Thermal expansion તથા cleaning પ્રમાણે fixed tube sheet,U-tube અથવા floating-head design પસંદ થાય છે;આ variants છે,દરેક unit માં બધાં parts હોય એવું નથી. એક stream tube-side channel થી tubes માં જાય છે અને બીજું shell માંથી baffles દર્શાવેલા માર્ગે tubes ની બહાર વહે છે. Tube wall મારફતે heat transfer થાય છે,intended fluid mixing નહીં. Baffles થી crossflow તથા mixing વધે છે,પણ pressure drop પણ વધે છે. Actual temperature pattern nozzle/pass arrangement નક્કી કરે છે. ઘણી practical units pure single-pass counterflow નથી,તેથી LMTD correction factor જરૂરી છે. Tube અથવા tube-sheet joint leak થાય તો cross-contamination થઈ શકે છે. Process heaters,coolers,condensers તથા reboilers તરીકે broad pressure/temperature ranges માં ઉપયોગી છે. યોગ્ય drainage,venting,cleaning access તથા thermal expansion allowance જરૂરી છે. Fouling અને vibration થી performance/reliability ઘટે છે. Inspection પહેલાં isolate,depressurise અને cool કરવું.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Plate heat exchanger—construction and working.
q.gu: Plate Heat Exchanger—Construction અને Working ની વ્યાખ્યા/મૂળ સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A plate-and-frame exchanger contains a stack of thin corrugated metal plates clamped between a fixed frame plate and a movable pressure plate.Gaskets or an appropriate sealed construction form alternating hot and cold channels.Corner ports and gasket patterns route each fluid only into its intended passages.Tie bolts maintain compression and a carrying bar supports the plate pack.The sketch is the gasketed variant;brazed and welded designs differ. Hot and cold streams enter separate port systems and flow through alternate narrow channels,usually arranged approximately counter-current.Corrugations promote mixing and mechanically support plates.Heat conducts through each thin plate while adjacent fluids remain separated.Multiple parallel passages distribute flow across the plate pack;unequal distribution or fouling can reduce the effective area.Gasketed units can be opened for inspection after safe isolation. Compact,high area density,high coefficients and close temperature approach are major advantages.Gasket compatibility,pressure/temperature limits,channel blockage by solids and cleaning needs must be checked.A plate exchanger is not automatically suitable for every slurry or high-pressure service.
a.gu: Plate-and-frame exchanger માં thin corrugated metal plates નો stack fixed frame તથા movable pressure plate વચ્ચે clamp થાય છે. Gaskets અથવા યોગ્ય sealed construction થી alternating hot અને cold channels બને છે. Corner ports અને gasket pattern દરેક fluid ને તેના જ passages માં દોરે છે. Tie bolts compression જાળવે છે અને carrying bar plate pack ને support આપે છે. Diagram gasketed variant બતાવે છે;brazed તથા welded designs જુદા હોય છે. Hot અને cold streams અલગ ports થી alternate narrow channels માં સામાન્ય રીતે આશરે counter-current વહે છે. Corrugations mixing વધારે છે તથા plates ને mechanical support આપે છે. Thin plates મારફતે conduction થાય છે,પણ fluids અલગ રહે છે. Multiple parallel passages માં flow વહેંચાય છે. Unequal distribution અથવા fouling થી effective area ઘટે છે. Gasketed unit safe isolation પછી inspection માટે ખોલી શકાય છે. Compact size,વધુ area density,ઉંચા coefficients તથા close temperature approach મુખ્ય લાભ છે. Gasket compatibility,pressure/temperature limits,solids થી channel blockage તથા cleaning needs તપાસવી. દરેક slurry અથવા high-pressure service માટે plate exchanger આપમેળે યોગ્ય નથી.

q.en: State the assumptions for Parallel-flow LMTD—direct derivation.
q.gu: Parallel-flow LMTD—સીધી Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Steady state;no external loss;constant U and heat-capacity rates Cₕ=ṁₕcₚₕ,C꜀=ṁ꜀cₚ꜀;no phase change.Both fluids flow along increasing area coordinate A;θ=Tₕ−T꜀>0.
a.gu: Steady state;external loss નથી;U તથા Cₕ=ṁₕcₚₕ,C꜀=ṁ꜀cₚ꜀ constant;phase change નથી.બંને fluids વધતા area-coordinate A તરફ વહે છે;θ=Tₕ−T꜀>0.

q.en: State the assumptions for Counter-current LMTD—direct derivation.
q.gu: Counter-current LMTD—સીધી Derivation માટે જરૂરી assumptions જણાવો.

a.en: Steady state;no loss;constant U,Cₕ,C꜀;no phase change.Follow the hot-flow spatial direction:both Tₕ and T꜀ decrease in that direction.The cold fluid itself moves oppositely.θ=Tₕ−T꜀>0.
a.gu: Steady state;loss નથી;U,Cₕ,C꜀ constant;phase change નથી.Hot-flow ની spatial direction લો:આ દિશામાં Tₕ તથા T꜀ બંને ઘટે છે,પણ cold fluid વિરુદ્ધ દિશામાં વહે છે.θ=Tₕ−T꜀>0.

q.en: State the definition/principle of LMTD correction factor and equal-end limit.
q.gu: LMTD Correction Factor અને Equal-end Limit ની વ્યાખ્યા/મૂળ સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: For a multipass or crossflow exchanger,the actual mean driving difference is expressed as F times the ideal counter-current LMTD based on the same four terminal temperatures.F depends on the specific flow/pass arrangement and temperature ratios.Use the correct chart or validated correlation,not an arbitrary universal factor.Ordinary feasible charts give F at or below one;an infeasible temperature combination cannot be repaired by guessing F. If both positive terminal differences are equal,the logarithmic mean equals that common difference;the apparent zero-over-zero is a limit,not zero duty.For a sensible exchanger at steady state with negligible loss,use both stream balances and compare measured values rather than force an exact match.
a.gu: Multipass અથવા crossflow exchanger માટે actual mean driving difference ને સમાન ચાર terminal temperatures પરથી મળતા ideal counter-current LMTD ના F ગણા તરીકે દર્શાવાય છે. F flow/pass arrangement તથા temperature ratios પર આધારિત છે. યોગ્ય chart અથવા validated correlation વાપરો;universal guessed factor નહીં. સામાન્ય feasible charts માં F એક કે તેનાથી ઓછો હોય છે. Infeasible temperature combination ને guessed F થી સુધારી શકાય નહીં. બંને positive terminal differences સમાન હોય તો logarithmic mean તે common difference જેટલું થાય છે. દેખાતું zero-over-zero એક limit છે,zero duty નહીં. Steady sensible exchanger માં negligible loss હોય તો બંને stream balances લો. Measured values સરખાવો;જબરદસ્તી exact match ન બનાવો.

a.en: Steady radial transfer;inner/outer diameters dᵢ,dₒ;length L;wall conductivity k_w;film coefficients hᵢ,hₒ.Fouling resistances Rfᵢ″,Rfₒ″ are per unit of their own surface area,units m² K W⁻¹.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Scale formation,fouling and performance.
q.gu: Scale Formation,Fouling અને Performance ની વ્યાખ્યા/મૂળ સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Fouling is accumulation of unwanted deposits on a heat-transfer surface.Scale is a deposit often associated with precipitation/crystallisation of dissolved salts.Other fouling includes suspended solids,biological growth and reaction/corrosion products.Deposits create an added thermal resistance and may narrow the flow passage. For the same driving temperatures and area,fouling lowers overall U and duty;maintaining duty can require more utility or greater temperature difference.It can also increase pressure drop,maldistribution and local overheating.Control uses appropriate water treatment,filtration,compatible operating conditions,adequate flow and planned cleaning.Monitor temperatures,flow and pressure drop;choose cleaning chemistry only under the approved materials-compatible SOP.
a.gu: Heat-transfer surface પર અનિચ્છનીય deposits જમા થવાને Fouling કહે છે. Dissolved salts ના precipitation/crystallisation થી બનતો deposit ઘણીવાર Scale કહેવાય છે. Suspended solids,biological growth તથા reaction/corrosion products પણ fouling આપે છે. Deposits વધારાનો thermal resistance આપે છે અને flow passage સાંકડો કરી શકે છે. સમાન driving temperatures અને area માટે fouling થી overall U તથા duty ઘટે છે. Duty જાળવવા વધુ utility અથવા temperature difference જરૂરી થઈ શકે છે. Pressure drop,maldistribution તથા local overheating પણ વધી શકે છે. યોગ્ય water treatment,filtration,compatible conditions,adequate flow અને planned cleaning જરૂરી છે. Temperature,flow તથા pressure drop monitor કરો. Cleaning chemistry ફક્ત approved materials-compatible SOP મુજબ પસંદ કરવી.
